Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.ssh

Class KnownHostsManager

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.ssh.KnownHostsManager
All Implemented Interfaces:
com.jcraft.jsch.UserInfo
public final class KnownHostsManager extends Object implements com.jcraft.jsch.UserInfo
Trust-on-first-use (TOFU) host key verification for the SSH client.

Maintains a known_hosts file under ~/.lg3d/ssh/ and implements JSch's UserInfo contract so that:

  • An unseen host key is accepted once and recorded (TOFU).
  • A changed key is rejected outright (MITM protection) — the user must explicitly remove the old key before reconnecting.
  • Password/passphrase prompts are forwarded to the panel's UI.

This mirrors the pattern used by the ftp-client's SFTP backend (SftpRemoteClient.TofuUserInfo) with StrictHostKeyChecking=yes.
